The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Vindican|Vindican]] owned a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed]] '''lightsaber''' during the [[Great Galactic War]]. He wielded this saberstaff when he fought with his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Malgus]] against the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kao Cen Darach]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Satele Shan]] during the [[Battle of Korriban|Fall of Korriban]]. After falling in battle, his apprentice forced the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] from Vindican's hand and utilized it, to lethal effect, against the [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi Battlemaster]] Darach of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].
